title: Communicative
summary: COMMUNICATIVE, adjective 1. Inclined to communicate; ready to impart to others. In the sense of liberal of benefits, though legitimate, it is little used. 2. Disposed to impart or disclose, as knowled

inlines.v: COMMUNICATIVE, adjective 1. Inclined to communicate; ready to impart to others. In the sense of liberal of benefits, though legitimate, it is little used. 2. Disposed to impart or disclose, as knowledge, opinions, or facts; free to communicate; not reserved. We have paid for our want of prudence, and determine for the future to be less communicative
